span.p:
External
In: DICOM folder, config JSON, tandem STEP file, user settings
Out: STL, STEP, PDF sheet, config JSON

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Presentation layer, PySide6
MainWindow with nav buttons and dialogs
Six views: Import, Cylinder, Channels, Tandem, Export, Structures
Structures controls: Surface / Outlines / Both, selected-ROI opacity, and row highlight and clickable organ collision warnings
OrbitCameraViewer3d: AIS_Triangulation surfaces and AIS_Shape outlines

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Application state, QObject models
RadiotherapyApp with signals and values
DicomModel, CylinderModel, ChannelsModel, TandemModel
NavigationModel, DisplayModel, ShapeModel, StructuresModel, CollisionModel
SurfaceTask on a single QThreadPool worker; pending ROIs, generation and mesh cache
CollisionTask on a separate worker; revision-tagged results and temporary red needles

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Domain services
dicom: fileio, data, structures, load_structures, structure_list
mesh: cylinder, channel, tandem, notch, helper, intersections, fileio, structure_contours, structure_surfaces, needle_collisions
pdf: template_reference, canvas
settings: defaults, load, values, reset, needle_templates, cylinder_templates

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Libraries
PySide6, pydicom, pythonocc-core with OpenCASCADE, reportlab, matplotlib, numpy
scipy and scikit-image for reconstruction and collision geometry
